A Woman Doctor-Lina

女医生丽娜 · 168 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Born in a pigsty, Lina grew up in poverty. She was looked down upon by other children her age. But she intended to become a doctor after she came across Lin Qiaozhi by chance, who was delivering a talk about medicine to a crowd gathered around her. Before leaving, Lin encouraged her to continue her studies. With Lin’s support, Lina entered an institute and studied hard, leaving herself no time for entertainment. Her outspoken and modest manner earned her respect. Her excellent debating skills and ability to observe put others into the shade.

2Now, Lina has become a specialist in emergency medicine. She is well known for her kindness and considerate behaviour towards the poor. The organization she founded carried out campaigns and welfare projects to help reduce the death rate among people living in poverty. Her work is hard but worthwhile. She often refers to the connection between her achievement and Lin Qiaozhi, and says that her poor childhood is the bond between her and the poor.

高考英语3500词 · 16中文译文

女医生丽娜

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1丽娜出生在猪圈里，童年生活贫苦，同龄的孩子也瞧不起她。一次，她偶然遇到林巧稚，林巧稚正在给围在身边的人讲医学知识。从那以后，丽娜立志当一名医生。临走前，林巧稚鼓励她继续学习。在林巧稚的支持下，丽娜进了一所学院，学习十分刻苦，连娱乐的时间也没留。她直率而谦虚，因此赢得了大家的尊重。出色的辩论本领和观察能力也让她在同伴中脱颖而出。

2如今，丽娜已成为一名专门处理急症的医生。她对穷人友善又体贴，大家都知道。她创办的机构发起了多项活动和福利项目，帮助降低贫困人群的死亡率。工作很辛苦，却很值得。她常常谈起自己的成就与林巧稚的关系，也说正是那段贫苦的童年让她和穷人紧紧联系在一起。
